mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product p JOIN users u ON p.userIdx = u.userIdx

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM rnum, tb.* FROM ( SELECT p.productIdx, p.title, p.price, p.userIdx, u.nickName, p.tradeType, p.tradeStatus, p.productStatus, p.hitCount, p.likeCount, p.chatCount, p.regionCode, r.dong, p.createdDate, p.lastUpDate, (SELECT imgUrl FROM productImages WHERE productIdx = p.productIdx AND imgOrder = 1) AS imgUrl FROM product p JOIN users u ON p.userIdx = u.userIdx LEFT JOIN region r ON p.regionCode = r.regionCode
ORDER BY p.productIdx DESC ) tb WHERE ROWNUM <= #{end} ) WHERE rnum >= #{start}

SELECT p.productIdx, p.title, p.content, p.price, p.shippingFee, p.userIdx, u.nickName, p.tradeType, p.tradeStatus, p.productStatus, p.hitCount, p.likeCount, p.chatCount, p.pullCount, p.tradePlace, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.regionCode, r.dong, p.categoryIdx, p.createdDate, p.updatedDate, p.lastUpDate FROM product p JOIN users u ON p.userIdx = u.userIdx LEFT JOIN region r ON p.regionCode = r.regionCode WHERE p.productIdx = #{productIdx}
SELECT productIdx, imgOrder, originalName, saveName, imgUrl FROM productImages WHERE productIdx = #{productIdx} ORDER BY imgOrder ASC
SELECT t.tagName FROM productTag pt JOIN tag t ON pt.tagIdx = t.tagIdx WHERE pt.productIdx = #{productIdx}
